description: Split from defk-0ha step 2 with its framing corrected. The hand-synced part is the message FRAGMENTS (the @arith/@arg match keys in Defk.Test and the literal strings at 57 sites in priv/defk_runtime.h and 17 in ElixirMode.Ops/Bits - what crc32c tripped over). Honest payoff: the taxonomy stops being hand-synced, it does NOT die - native and Elixir-mode messages can never be byte-identical where they carry formatted values (C prints floats as C does). Shape: one Elixir module of fragments, a generated priv/defk_messages.h of defines (dev-time mix task + mix ci check, like the generated docs), runtime.h's raise sites switched to the defines, Ops/Bits and Defk.Test's taxonomy consuming the module. A defk-ch4-sized C edit: gate byte-identical for kernel C (the header is not in the dump), message-equality pinned by raise_test and the exact-message agreement sites.

comments.text: PR #19 opened (https://github.com/DanielLuning/defk/pull/19): Defk.Messages single-sources the templates; priv/defk_messages.h generated by mix defk.messages; runtime.h uses DEFK_MSG_ defines only; Ops/Bits use Messages.text/2; Defk.Test.agreement_reason delegates to Messages.reason/1. mix ci green on macOS arm64; dump_c byte-identical apart from DEFK_HEADER_HASH and a path-hashed loop key. Ticket stays in progress until the owner merges.
